description:
About E2B

E2B is a fast-growing Series A startup with over $37M in funding and 9-figure revenue. We are building the Agent Cloud and power the infrastructure behind AI labs and some of the most widely used consumer and enterprise agents, including Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, and Artificial Analysis. Our team includes original authors of Firecracker, the AWS microVM technology powering Lambda, along with alumni of Cognition, JetBrains, Zapier, and Wish.

Why this role exists

Developers find E2B through code they can run: a demo, a cookbook recipe, a talk where a sandbox does something they didn’t expect. Today nearly all of that comes out of San Francisco. Much of our engineering team sits in Prague, Europe has its own fast-growing community of people building agents, and nobody at E2B is responsible for them.

You’ll be E2B’s first DevRel engineer in Europe. You’ll build the demos, give the talks and run the meetups, working closely with the engineers in Prague who build the product.

What you will own

  • Technical content: end-to-end demos (code, article and video), cookbook recipes and example apps showing E2B inside the frameworks and tools developers already use.

  • The European developer community: meetups, workshops and hackathons in Prague, London, Berlin and Paris, and E2B’s presence at the region’s AI and developer conferences.

  • Talks. You present E2B on stage and you build the demos you present.

  • Integrations and joint launches with European AI labs, frameworks and startups. You turn a partnership into something a developer can run.

  • The feedback loop. You work closely with the Prague engineering team and bring them what developers struggle with, as issues and pull requests, not slide decks.

  • Community support in European hours across Discord and GitHub.

  • A part in E2B’s first conference in 2027: talks, workshops and demos.

  • Reading the numbers and acting on them. You know which content and events drive signups, GitHub stars and SDK usage, and you pick what to build next from that.

What a strong candidate looks like

Must-haves:

  • You write good code in Python and TypeScript and have built with AI agent frameworks or LLM tooling.

  • A public body of work you made: talks, repos, posts or videos that developers have used.

  • Comfortable on stage and on camera, in English.

  • Writes in a voice that reads as native to developers.

  • More than 3 years of relevant experience. This can be DevRel, developer marketing, or engineering plus a habit of building in public.

  • Happy to travel within Europe often and to San Francisco a few times a year.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Existing ties to European AI and developer communities.

  • Open-source contributions.

  • Experience organizing meetups or hackathons.

  • An existing developer following on X or YouTube.

Location: Remote in Europe, with London or Berlin preferred. Expect regular trips to our Prague office.

What it’s like to work at E2B

We’re a fast-growing startup with in-person (4 days on-site, 1 day WFH) offices in San Francisco and Prague, Czech Republic. We already generate 9-figure revenue and work directly with top-tier AI companies like Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, Artificial Analysis and other exciting teams pushing the frontier of AI.

We offer healthcare, vision, and dental insurance, unlimited PTO, 401k, and a variety of perks for in-office employees.
